summary: Load a ML model from a STAC Item
description:
Loads a machine learning model from a STAC Item.

Such a model could be trained and saved as part of a previous batch job with processes such as ``ml_fit()`` and ``save_ml_model()`` or be hosted externally. The STAC Item must implement version 1.4 or later of the [Machine Learning Model (`mlm`) extension](https://github.com/stac-extensions/mlm).

Before the model is used, the back-end checks whether it can run the model and fails early instead of adapting silently. The model is rejected if the back-end does not support the declared ``mlm:framework`` or ``mlm:artifact_type``, if the installed framework differs from ``mlm:framework_version`` in its major version, or if ``mlm:accelerator_constrained`` is ``true`` and the declared ``mlm:accelerator`` is not available. A difference in the minor version is allowed but must be reported in the logs.

parameters.name: uri
parameters.description: The STAC Item to load the machine learning model from. The STAC Item must implement the [`mlm`](https://github.com/stac-extensions/mlm) extension. This parameter can point to a remote STAC Item via ``URL`` or a local JSON file.

parameters.name: model_asset
parameters.description: The Asset name of the given STAC Item which represents the actual ML model. The asset must list ``mlm:model`` as its role. If only one asset lists ``mlm:model`` as its role, this parameter is optional as this asset will be used by default. If multiple assets list ``mlm:model`` as their role, this parameter is required to determine which asset to use.

parameters.name: input_index
parameters.description: STAC:MLM items supports multiple ML model input specification. This parameter specifies the index of the input specification in the ``mlm:input`` array to use for prediction or training. As ``mlm:input`` is an array, the first input in the array has index 0.

parameters.name: output_index
parameters.description: STAC:MLM items supports multiple ML model output specification. This parameter specifies the index of the output specification in the ``mlm:output`` array to use for prediction or training. As ``mlm:output`` is an array, the first output in the array has index 0.

returns.description: A machine learning model to be used with machine learning processes such as ``ml_predict()``.

ModelFrameworkUnsupported.message: The machine learning framework '{framework}' declared in `mlm:framework` is not supported by the back-end.

ModelArtifactTypeUnsupported.message: The model artifact type '{type}' declared in `mlm:artifact_type` is not supported by the back-end.

ModelFrameworkVersionMismatch.message: The model requires version {required} of the framework (`mlm:framework_version`), but the back-end provides the incompatible version {installed}.

ModelAcceleratorUnavailable.message: The model is constrained to the accelerator '{accelerator}' (`mlm:accelerator_constrained`), which is not available.

ModelAssetAmbiguous.message: Multiple assets list `mlm:model` as their role. Specify the asset to use in the parameter `model_asset`.
